blurb: Guests can take group or private lessons in sea kayaking and stand up paddleboarding, including beginner and advanced skills. Rentals of single and double kayaks and SUPs are available by the hour or day, with some overnight options. Safety and cancellation policies require waivers, age minimums, and proof of rescue skills for solo paddling.
